quests.title: The Dead Patch at Exhibition Centre
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The number three green at Exhibition Centre has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since school holidays, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Exhibition Centre
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by school holidays, which means finding $44 that the Exhibition Centre club does not have. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $44, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Exhibition Centre Membership Count
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Our books say 55 members at Exhibition Centre and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Exhibition Centre
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Since five in the morning somebody has been going round the Exhibition Centre greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Exhibition Centre
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. There is a roll of raffle tickets in the chest freezer behind the bar at Exhibition Centre and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Exhibition Centre
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Glebe now, and he owes Exhibition Centre an explanation about the drainage. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

wherever it stops

the car in the space with the number painted beside it
